name: Mibhar
title: One of David's mighty warriors
summary: Mibhar, son of Hagri, was one of King David's mighty warriors mentioned in Chronicles. He belonged to the select group of elite soldiers who served David faithfully. His name appears in the list of David's heroes, although details about his exploits are limited.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Mibhar, son of Hagri, is listed among David's mighty men who served the king with distinction in battle.

keyEvents.title: David's elite warriors gather
keyEvents.description: Mibhar was part of the group of mighty men who surrounded David and helped him establish and defend his kingdom over Israel.

keyEvents.title: Service in David's army
keyEvents.description: As one of David's heroes, Mibhar contributed to the military victories that secured David's rule over all Israel and Judah.

keyEvents.title: The list of the thirty mighty men
keyEvents.description: Mibhar is part of the extended list of David's heroes, often referred to as 'the Thirty,' who formed the core of David's military leadership.
